entries.source: This humanoid has been enslaved by the yaech's mental powers.
entries.target: 这个人形生物已被夺魂魔的心灵力量奴役。

entries.source: This huge ritch seems to be the mother of all those here. Her sharp, fiery, claws dart toward you!
entries.target: 这只巨大的里奇似乎是这里所有里奇的母亲。她锋利而炽热的爪子向你扑来！

entries.source: You should not go there. There is no way back. Ever. Maybe later when you have done all you must do.
entries.target: 你不应该去那里。那里没有回头路，永远没有。也许等你做完了所有必须做的事之后再来吧。

entries.source: Time seems to slow down around the orb.
entries.target: 水晶球周围的时间似乎变慢了。

entries.source: Your mind is filled with strange thoughts as you approach the orb.
entries.target: 当你靠近水晶球时，脑海中充满了奇怪的念头。

entries.source: The orb seems to corrupt all it touches.
entries.target: 水晶球似乎会腐化它所接触的一切。

entries.source: Ruined Dungeon
#rng# the Guardian
Guardian
You can hear a magical trigger firing off.
entries.target: 你听到了魔力开关触动的声音。

entries.source: Strange Orb
The orb seems to react badly to your touch; there is a high shriek!
entries.target: 这只水晶球在你的触摸下反应很糟；你听到了一声尖叫！

entries.source: The orb burns to your touch and a loud shout screams out!
entries.target: 这颗水晶球摸上去滚烫，一声响亮的呼喊冲天而起！

entries.source: The orb reacts violently to your touch and the walls begin to rumble!
entries.target: 这只水晶球在你的触摸下反应剧烈，墙壁开始颤抖！

entries.source: %s appears out of the thin air!
The orb glows brightly. There is a loud crack coming from the northern central chamber.
entries.target: 水晶球闪耀着光芒。北部中央大厅传来一声巨响。

entries.source: The orb glows brightly.
undead
skeleton
The Shade
This skeleton looks nasty. There are red flames in its empty eye sockets. It wields a nasty sword and strides toward you, throwing spells.
entries.target: 这只骷髅看起来很邪恶。它的眼眶里有红色的燃烧火焰。它手持一把大剑冲向你，并向你投掷法术。

entries.source: and left to rot
.. yes I tell you! The old ruins of Kor'Pul are still haunted!
entries.target: …是的，我告诉你！卡·普尔的古老废墟仍然闹鬼！

entries.source: The Possessed
He is the leader of a gang of bandits that killed the Shade of Kor'Pul, however it is obvious the Shade was merely displaced. It is now possessing the corpse of his killer.
entries.target: 这是那伙杀死暗影骷髅的强盗的头目，但显然暗影骷髅只是被驱离了原先的躯体，如今它附身在了杀死自己的强盗头目尸体上。

entries.source: and used as a new host
ghost
Kor's Fury
The Shade's colossal will keeps it anchored to this world, now as a vengeful, insane spirit.
entries.target: 暗影的巨大意志使它锚定在这个世界上，如今它是一个充满复仇与疯狂的灵魂。

entries.source: journal page
A journal page, left by an adventurer.
entries.target: 由冒险家留下的日记书页。

entries.source: Ruins of Kor'Pul
vermin
sandworm
sandworm burrower

This sandworm seems to not care about your presence at all and simply continues digging its way through the sand.
	
Maybe following it is the only way to move around here...
entries.target:
这只沙虫似乎毫不在意你的出现，只顾埋头挖掘。
	
也许跟着它才是在这一带四处走动的唯一办法……

entries.source: huge sandworm burrower
Sandworm Queen
Before you stands the queen of the sandworms. Massive and bloated, she slithers toward you, calling for her offspring!
entries.target: 在你面前站着的是沙虫女皇。她庞大而臃肿，蜿蜒蠕行着向你逼近，同时还在召唤自己的子孙！

entries.source: and swallowed whole
Rumbling...
The ground shakes.  Something very large is stirring in the distance.
entries.target: 大地震颤起来。远处似乎有什么庞然大物正在蠢动。

entries.source: Did you hear? Something seems to have devoured all the last sandworms!
entries.target: 你听说了吗？有什么东西把所有剩下的沙虫都吞噬了！

entries.source: dragon
sand
Corrupted Sand Wyrm
The sandworms are gone, devoured by this shrieking, warped horror.
entries.target: 沙虫们已经消失了，被这只尖啸着的扭曲怪物吞噬殆尽。

entries.source: Song of the Sands
Some people get the weirdest ideas!
entries.target: 有些人有最奇怪的想法！

entries.source: corpse
heart
Heart of the Sandworm Queen
pulsing organ

The heart of the Sandworm Queen, ripped from her dead body.
You could ... consume it, should you feel mad enough or you could try to corrupt it somewhere.
entries.target:
从沙虫女皇尸体上割下的心脏。
你可以……吃了它，如果你足够疯的话，你还可以在别的地方腐化它。

entries.source: consume the heart
#00FFFF#You consume the heart and feel the knowledge of this very old creature fill you!
entries.target: #00FFFF#你吃下了心脏，你感觉被这个古老生物的知识充满！

entries.source: You are transformed by the heart of the Queen!
entries.target: 你被沙虫女皇之心所转化！

entries.target: 一瓶粘稠的浑浊液体。天知道你喝了它之后会发生什么？

entries.source: red
Atamathon's Lost Ruby Eye
entries.target: 阿塔玛森丢失的红宝石眼睛

entries.source:
One of the ruby eyes of the legendary giant golem Atamathon.
It is said it was made by the halflings during the Age of Pyre as a weapon against the orcs. Even though it was destroyed it managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader, Garkul the Devourer.
entries.target:
传奇巨像阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛之一。
据说阿塔玛森是半身人在烈火纪为了对抗兽人所造的武器。这具傀儡虽然最终被毁，但还是成功杀死了兽人首领吞噬者加库尔，给兽人以重创。

#OLIVE_DRAB#You feel the ground shaking from the west.
entries.target: #OLIVE_DRAB#你感觉到西边的大地在震动。
